description: Backend API routes for commission management and check-in/check-out workflow. Includes admin commission settings endpoint, center check-in/check-out endpoints with automatic commission calculation, commission calculation utility, and permission middleware updates for DOCTOR role. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema changes).
steps: Update lib/middleware/permissions.ts: add 'DOCTOR' to UserRole type, create requireDoctor() helper, create getUserDoctorId(userId) helper similar to getUserCenterId and getUserPatientId

Create lib/commission.ts with calculateCommission function: accepts bookingPrice, commissionRate, commissionType, fixedAmount; returns { commissionAmount, centerEarnings } with proper rounding to 2 decimals

Create app/api/admin/centers/commission/route.ts: POST endpoint requiring admin role, accepts { centerId, commissionRate?, commissionType?, fixedCommissionAmount? }, validates rate 0-100 for PERCENTAGE, updates centers table, returns updated center

Create app/api/center/checkin/route.ts: POST endpoint requiring center role, accepts { bookingId }, validates booking belongs to center's doctor and status is CONFIRMED, sets checkedInAt timestamp and checkedInBy to current user, returns updated booking

Create app/api/center/checkout/route.ts: POST endpoint requiring center role, accepts { bookingId }, validates booking is checked in and belongs to center, fetches center commission settings, calculates commission using lib/commission.ts, updates booking with checkedOutAt, checkedOutBy, status=COMPLETED, commissionAmount, centerEarnings, commissionStatus=CALCULATED, returns booking with commission details
Update app/api/bookings/route.ts GET handler: add DOCTOR role case to fetch bookings where doctorId matches getUserDoctorId(user.id), filter out commission fields for PATIENT role responses

Create app/api/doctors/register/route.ts: POST endpoint requiring DOCTOR role, accepts { name, specialization, licenseNumber, consultationFee, bio?, imageUrl? }, validates user doesn't have existing doctor profile, creates doctor record with userId=user.id, centerId=null, isIndependent=true, active=false, returns created profile

Update app/api/doctors/route.ts GET handler: modify query to include independent doctors (where centerId is null OR centerId matches filter), handle nullable centerId in WHERE clause using and() with optional conditions
Test all new endpoints with Thunder Client or curl: verify admin commission setting, center check-in, center check-out with commission calculation, doctor registration, and bookings GET for all roles

Verify commission calculation accuracy: create test bookings with different prices and commission settings (percentage and fixed), check out, confirm commissionAmount and centerEarnings match manual calculations
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with no TypeScript errors
POST /api/admin/centers/commission as admin successfully updates center commission settings
POST /api/center/checkin as center sets checkedInAt timestamp and checkedInBy user ID
POST /api/center/checkout as center after check-in calculates commission correctly and sets status to COMPLETED
Commission calculation is accurate: 15% of $100 = $15 commission, $85 earnings
Fixed commission calculation works: $20 fixed on $100 = $20 commission, $80 earnings
GET /api/bookings as DOCTOR returns only that doctor's bookings
GET /api/bookings as PATIENT excludes commission fields from response
POST /api/doctors/register as DOCTOR creates independent doctor profile with centerId=null
GET /api/doctors includes both center-affiliated and independent doctors when no centerId filter
verification: Run npm run build and verify exit code 0
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/admin/centers/commission -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"centerId":"test-id","commissionRate":15}' with admin auth; expect 200 status
Query centers table: SELECT commission_rate, commission_type FROM centers WHERE id='test-id'; expect rate=15, type=PERCENTAGE
Create CONFIRMED booking, curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/center/checkin -d '{"bookingId":"booking-id"}' with center auth; expect checked_in_at set
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/center/checkout -d '{"bookingId":"booking-id"}' with center auth; expect commission_amount calculated
Query booking: SELECT price, commission_amount, center_earnings, status FROM bookings WHERE id='booking-id'; verify commission = price * 0.15, status = COMPLETED
GET /api/bookings as DOCTOR user; verify response includes only bookings for that doctor's ID
POST /api/doctors/register as DOCTOR user; query doctors: SELECT user_id, center_id, is_independent FROM doctors WHERE user_id='doctor-user-id'; expect center_id=null, is_independent=true
